svg.title: Greyhound Hub 2.0 System Flowchart
svg.desc: Professional system flowchart based on the current Greyhound Hub 2.0 CodeIgniter codebase, showing role-based access, file management, upload AI processing, duplicate handling, department requests, transmit, direct send, authorized files, mobile publishing, published files, recent, iFound, notifications, and audit logs.
svg.text: Current CodeIgniter web/admin system with API, AI processing, department distribution, and mobile publishing
Prepared for BSIT Capstone Project presentation and documentation
Verified from Routes.php, AuthController, Filters.php, app_header.php, and RolePolicy.php.
No: return to login with error
2. File Management, Upload, AI Processing, And Duplicate Handling
Verified from WorkspaceController::media, ::upload, ::duplicateQueue, post-upload automation, StorageService, EventDetectionService, PassportService, and WatermarkService.
files, folder, tag, duplicate_media, AI, passports
3. Department Requests, Transmit, Direct Send, Authorized Files, And Notifications
Verified from DistributionController, DistributionService, WorkspaceController department file filtering, and NotificationController.
4. Mobile App Publishing, Published Files, API, And Public Visibility
Verified from WorkspaceController::postMedia, ::publishedFiles, Routes.php, and MobileFeedController.

Source checked: app/Config/Routes.php, app/Views/layouts/app_header.php, app/Libraries/RolePolicy.php, WorkspaceController, DistributionController, NotificationController, MobileFeedController, services, README, and architecture docs.
Functional boundary: legacy flat-PHP code and old mobile server remain reference/migration material; the diagram follows the active CodeIgniter web/API flow.
